capabilities.rationale: Local verified registration, password sign-in, profile editing, session rotation, and sign-out are required by the supplied tasks.
Local password recovery uses indistinguishable public responses and the generated WebsiteBench auth runtime.
Registration and password-reset verification use the site-branded local-only outbox. Real email is not authorized and no provider is called.
GitLab project collaboration tasks create no order analogue.
Pricing is informational. No subscription checkout is implemented.
No payment task is in scope. The runtime keeps local-sandbox as its inert default, and the app exposes no payment surface.
Accounts, sessions, projects, repositories, branches, commits, issues, merge requests, pipelines, memberships, settings, and activity require one site-bound SQLite database.
